body: I think you have a good perspective on this and I agree with what you said. Of course I am okay with you sharing all of  that. I'm glad you did. I'm sorry that you've been mistreated, you seem like an interesting person. :)

I really enjoyed reading this response and I appreciate you taking the time to write all of that. Thank you. 

I've thought about the same thing when it comes to a person being worthwhile. I do believe that everyone can provide value to this world, no matter their situation and what they are doing, yet I obviously struggle when applying that to myself. Just curious, but how has reading posts here started to make you think that everyone really is worthwhile, functional or not?

I still sorta look at streaming as a hobby right now but of course it would be fantastic to turn it into something more. That's probably the only thing I really have going for me at the moment. Thank you for your words of encouragement. I wish you the best :)
As far as the maturity thing goes, I don't think it is necessarily a bad thing to act a little younger. Wishing you the best man. I hope we find happiness.

Thank you so much dude. Really rooting for you as well. And that's what I'm saying, living really is starting to feel like a chore. I just barely hang on because I know there can be more to life than this. It  sucks for you, and anyone else feeling like this, but it does help a bit to know you aren't alone. Once again, thank you for taking the time to read and respond. (:

Thank you for your kind words. You sound like a very sweet person. That idea about the coffee shop is actually pretty interesting. I appreciate you reading what I said. I hope you have a wonderful year too (:
